purpose: Extend ModelState with lastSwitched field and fill assertS7 to enforce identity-isolation invariant: after any Sw command, the post-switch context must not hold tasks belonging to groups the prior identity was a member of.
owned_data: ModelState.lastSwitched: { context: ActorId; priorGroupIds: string[] } | null
test_targets: AC-S7-1: ModelState.lastSwitched initialised to null in constructor AND reset in model.reset()
AC-S7-2: SwCommand.run populates lastSwitched BEFORE the switch, capturing priorGroupIds
AC-S7-3: assertS7 reads post-switch __notestrTestTasks and asserts no task carries a groupId in priorGroupIds
AC-S7-4: when lastSwitched is null, assertS7 returns without asserting
AC-S7-5: stale comment removed from assertS7 body
